raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Cognizant Technology Solutions |Pune, India / Amsterdam, Netherlands Business Analyst (Client: ING Bank) | July 2021 – Present • Agile Delivery & Leadership: Acted as Scrum Master for a 12-member cross-functional team, managing the end-to-end SDLC. Standardized daily syncs and backlog refinement, improving sprint predictability by 15% and on-time delivery rates.
Requirements & Documentation: Translated complex regulatory requirements into
comprehensive BRDs, FSDs, data mapping documents, and actionable agile user stories, reducing development rework.
Data Quality Optimization: Engineered automated data quality KPI checks using
Advanced SQL, successfully elevating overall data accuracy and completeness by 20%.
Deep-Dive Analysis: Executed complex SQL queries to perform deep-dive data
validation, anomaly detection, and cross-system reconciliation, ensuring data integrity across critical risk systems.
Regulatory Compliance (BCBS 239): Spearheaded impact analyses for changing regulatory directives (including BCBS 239 and local risk protocols), ensuring 100% compliance across all interconnected data systems.
Process Improvement: Optimized the end-to-end operational workflow by 10-12% through targeted process re-engineering, proactive KPI monitoring, and continuous stakeholder alignment.
UAT & Deployment: Designed comprehensive UAT test plans, coordinated multi-team execution, triaged defects, and ensured seamless, zero-critical-defect production go- lives. Incident Management: Conducted detailed root-cause analysis (RCA) for data incidents in production, resolving recurring structural issues and substantially improving SLA compliance.

Key Onsite Engagement: ING Bank, Amsterdam • Data Migration Triage: Played a pivotal role in major data migration go-lives activities, performing high-stakes data validation, reconciliation, and triaging critical production issues under tight deployment deadlines.
Stakeholder Management: Facilitated complex requirement clarification workshops with business owners, data stewards, model validators, and IT architecture teams, mitigating gaps and strengthening offshore-onsite collaboration.
raw_sections.education: Education Bachelor of Technology (Computer Science Engineering), Silicon Institute of Technology, Bhubaneswar (July 2017– June 2021) | CGPA: 8.55
